# Vendored calculation and timezone data

- adhan.esm.min.mjs is the browser ESM bundle from adhan 4.4.6 by Batoul Apps, distributed under the MIT License. The license text is in adhan-LICENSE.txt.
- tz-lookup.mjs is the timezone-boundary dataset from tz-lookup 6.1.25 by Dark Sky, distributed under CC0 1.0.

Upstream projects:

- https://github.com/batoulapps/adhan-js
- https://github.com/darkskyapp/tz-lookup

The files are stored locally so prayer calculations and coordinate-to-timezone lookup do not depend on a CDN.
